items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: I knew him since I was there. I never knew him to have a job.

ctx.x: We'll ask and I'll go over there sometime and ask around there. Somebody will know that. Where was the Elmira Pleasure Ground? Fess told us about that, but he didn't seem... The Elmira Pleasure Ground. Yeah, Elmira Pleasure Ground.
